description_expanded: OverviewHot TubSteps to the deeded beach access-8 bikes-Private pool/Heat option & hot tub `Hacienda Blanca`The Space Luxury Coastal Estate | Steps to Private Beach | Pool, Hot Tub & Gulf Views! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: 100 Yards to Private Beach Access – Enjoy the sugar-white sands of 30A Private Pool & Hot Tub (Heat Option Available) – Relax in your own oasis Wine Cellar & Wet Bar – Perfect for entertaining Gulf Views & Expansive Balconies – Breathtaking coastal scenery 6 Bedrooms | 5 Full Baths | 2 Half Baths – Accommodates up to 20 Guests 2 Master Suites – King beds, en-suite baths, & luxury finishes Spacious Bunk Room – 2 Queen-over-Queen bunks, private living room & bath Interior & Exterior Fireplaces – Cozy ambiance indoors & out Chef’s Kitchen – Marble countertops, farmhouse sink & premium appliances Outdoor Entertaining – Firepit, grill, dining table & ample seating Expansive Balcony w/ Porch Swings – Relax & enjoy Gulf breezes 6 FREE Bikes Included – Explore 30A in style Elevator Access – Easy mobility between floors Driveway Parking for 6 Cars Professionally Managed, 24/7 ServiceWelcome to Hacienda Blanca"Hacienda Blanca" in Seacrest West distinguishes itself with elegance and sophistication. This recently completed home is spacious enough to accommodate 20 guests in its 6 bedrooms, 5 full bathrooms and 2 half baths. The first floor features a master suite equipped with a fireplace, jacuzzi bathtub, double vanity and a walk-in shower adjacent to an open living area and kitchen. A serene kitchen with lovely white marble, a farmhouse sink, and premium appliances has everything guests need. Next to the kitchen is a second master suite with a king-sized bed and a walk-in shower and bath tub. Sliding glass doors open to a private pool and spillover spa. The back yard includes an exterior firepit, a gas grill, a dining table and plenty of seating to soak up some sun.Take the stairs or the elevator up to the second floor where you'll find an expansive balcony with 2 large porch swings. Continuing back inside is a guest room featuring a king-sized bed and en suite bathroom. Down the hall is a large bunk room with 2 queen over queen bunk beds, its own living room and private bathroom. Another guest room greets you with 2 queen sized beds and an en suite bathroom. You'll find a spacious living room and another guest room equipped with a queen-sized bed before heading up to the third floor.The third floor provides access to a wet bar, living area, wine fridge and plenty of seating for everyone. The balcony enjoys views of the gulf and access to a gas firepit. Located just steps from the beach, Hacienda Blanca is sure to accommodate all your vacation desires.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**Pool Heat *Pool heating available for this property from October 1st through May 1st*Fee $50 per day and required for length of stay*Pool heat is not guaranteed-please note pool and hot tub cannot be heated at the same time.*Please choose to heat one option; pool or hot tub for your stay.*No Cable. Streaming Only**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (20):Master bedroom - King sized bed, en suite bathroomMaster Bedroom - King sized bed, en suite bathroomGuest Bedroom - King sized bed, en suite bathroomGuest Bedroom - 2 Queen sized beds, en suite bathroomGuest Bedroom - Queen sized bedBunk Room - 2 Queen over queen bunks, en suite bathroom***Carriage house is rented separately but can be rented in conjunction with the main house***Casita BlancaAREA ATTRACTIONS:This easygoing beach neighborhood is the perfect place to escape for a beach vacation. Spend a day wandering through the shops and sights of Seacrest — you’ll spot everything from gorgeous dune lakes to gourmet restaurants. Then, unwind with a stroll along Seacrest’s sugar-white sand.You can find historic Alys Beach 0.5 miles east. Slightly further east you can enjoy the lively community that gathers in Seacrest’s Peddler’s Pavilion. Sip coffee on an outdoor patio, stock up on homemade sweet treats, or rent a bicycle and go exploring. With wide-open green spaces and plenty of ecosploring opportunities, this beach neighborhood is a perfect fit for active vacationers.Show less
